offers_products.reason: Sells cloud communications software (RingEX, RingCX, AI Receptionist) as SaaS, plus some phone hardware.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from SaaS subscriptions; services are not a main offering beyond support.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells business phone, messaging, video and contact-center platforms to organizations, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Over 600,000 businesses, schools, banks and healthcare organizations use its communications platform.

recurring_revenue.reason: Subscription plans for RingEX and RingCX, billed monthly or annually.

cyclical_demand.reason: Business phone systems are essential operating infrastructure and are rarely cancelled in downturns, though seat counts can shrink.

big_ticket.reason: Small recurring per-user subscription fees, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for the software platform and network, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customer base spans small businesses to Fortune 1000, with a large small and mid-size business share.

asset_heavy.reason: Cloud software model; growth needs R&D and cloud capacity, not plants, fleets or properties.

notes: Customer size is mixed, with an SMB-heavy base and some enterprise customers.
